messages:
Kaya (CS Ops): Quick flag 5m: this morning several customers received duplicate enablement nudge emails after the new playbook automation went live.
Ben (CS Tools): Thanks, any example account ids?
Kaya (CS Ops): acct 7122 and 7340. Both had 2 active trial contacts, playbook fired for each contact.
Diego (AE): Yep saw it on acct 73402. I got two identical touchpoint notifications and customer asked why they got repeated outreach.
Ava (Data Eng): Could be webhook fanout. Our event service emits one event per contact if contact-level webhook is subscribed.
Ben (CS Tools): Current dedupe logic: dedupe by email, then by contact_id, then owner_null fallback. If webhook emits multiple contact-level events, contact_id will differ so it re-runs.
Kaya (CS Ops): Suggested quick fixes: 1) tighten fallback to require owner_null AND last_touch > 21d; 2) add short-term suppression API so AEs can suppress for 7 days; 3) add audit for suppression.
Ben (CS Tools): Agreed. I'll implement the fallback change and suppression endpoint. Will roll out as a 10% canary first.
Ava (Data Eng): Also recommend we move engagement_decay in health scoring from 3d -> 14d. Automation firing was causing noisy 'engagement_low' flags. I can run a 90-day backtest to quantify impact.
Kaya (CS Ops): Please run that backtest, Ava. We need numbers before adjusting global thresholds.
Ava (Data Eng): Will run and post results later today.
Ben (CS Tools): Plan: patch dedupe -> staging -> 10% canary 24h -> expand. Add suppression table: playbook_suppression_log(account_id, user, reason, expires_at, created_at).
Diego (AE): Add my accounts to canary: 7122.
Ben (CS Tools): Added. playbook-bot will tag canary accounts in logs with :canary:.
playbook-bot: Canary toggle enabled in staging. Use `/playbook status canary` to view list.
Kaya (CS Ops): I'll monitor CS tickets and notify affected AEs once PR is merged.
Ben (CS Tools): Opening PR now. CI running.
